notes: THE CONTENT LAYER NO LONGER OFFERS A SWITCH THAT DOES NOTHING. Layers > Content carried an On/Off toggle that wrote a setting (sensorsEnabled) the OG Widget renderer reads exactly zero times — flipping it changed nothing on screen, ever…

THE SWITCH IS NOW DECLARED BY THE THEME, NOT DECIDED BY THE EDITOR. Rather than hiding it on a hardcoded panel name, each theme declares contentToggle — the theme is the only thing that knows whether it draws a readout band separable from…

The Content layer note stopped describing a control that is not there. Where the switch is absent it now reads "Required; cannot be removed — on this panel the readings ARE the panel", instead of telling the user to toggle a visibility…
